result_text:
The warehouse stock list now leaves out products whose quantity is 0. I ran the full test suite offline and it passed. I didn't add a test for the new behaviour, and nothing in the suite exercised the old query.

The change is in `DataStore.findStockLevelsByWarehouse`, in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `AND s.quantity > 0` to its query and updated the Javadoc to match. `StockService.getWarehouseStock` calls it, so the list is filtered there too.

`StockService.getQuantity` uses a separate query, so asking for the quantity of nuts in WH-1 still answers 0.
